## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. Link an issue if there is one. -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] Harness code, config or docs
- [ ] New or updated model entry in `config/models.json`
- [ ] Published results (`results/<suite>/<model-id>/`, generated by `python3 -m decision_bench publish`)
- [ ] Corpus (a new version; existing versions are never edited)
- [ ] Site

## Checks

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] `python3 -m decision_bench validate` reports no problems
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_secrets.py` finds nothing
- [ ] No API keys, endpoint URLs, private hostnames or local paths in any file
